Mom! Dad! Check your phones! Now!
It's 6 a.m. Your bank app says one million dollars. Yesterday you had twelve.
Everybody got it. Every single person on Earth.
Day one. Your sister buys a horse. His name is Mister Pancake. He eats the doormat.
Day seven. Mom goes to the store for milk. A carton of milk now costs fifty dollars.
Everyone is rich, so the store raised the prices. By dinner, it's two hundred.
Day fourteen. The lights go out. The whole city. The people who run the power plant are on a yacht.
By day thirty, a loaf of bread is worth more than your million. And that's not even the worst part.
